policy.exact_match: Writes are authorized only by an exact SHA-256 match of the decompressed program.
policy.unknown_hash: Unknown program hashes are identified but never modified automatically.
policy.word_check: Every recovery site must match its expected original 32-bit PowerPC word before modification.
policy.confidence: Runtime-verified profiles apply normally. Other profiles require an explicit opt-in flag, and known-incomplete profiles require a second explicit opt-in.
